title: Treasury return body
description: An institution returns the credits it holds above its reserve to the Treasury (credits.md 3.3, CR-25; register row DK172; spec-delta S1566): the provider share of a city-run institution that has no costs in credits would only accumulate. Signed by the institution itself, once a month, for itself. The log keeps the reserve (the larger of 50 credits and what refunds the institution still owes on purchases it never answered) in the account (return_below_reserve), refuses the Bank, the Insurer (their accounts are reserves) and the Academy (its account holds prize pools: return_locked) and moves credits only: debits the institution and credits the Treasury, so the supply rule holds. Chain: none (prev is null). Credits are accounting entries, not money.
